checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One eight-second 16:9 video with no audio
must.why: Delivered a 3 s clip at 832×512 (not 16:9) plus the original 8 s clip. The user must join them. No single 8 s video exists.

must.item: First five seconds match the previous video's opening
must.why: The original clip is untouched, and the new ending starts from a similar scene, though it is softer and re-rendered.

must.item: Final three seconds: same plane lands on an open notebook on the wooden desk
must.why: At 2.8 s of the new clip the plane is still airborne, above a book stack and loose papers. It has not landed.

must.item: Plane rests on the notebook, not the bare desk
must.why: The plane never comes to rest in the new ending. The original clip's ending rests on the desk beside a paper stack, not on a clear notebook.

must.item: Sunny study and style consistent, no text
must.why: Same sunny study and look, with no text. The new ending is slightly blurrier and lower resolution.

faults.what: The new ending never lands. The plane is still in flight at 2.8 s of 3 s, and no notebook is visible.
No finished 8 s video was delivered. The user has to assemble it, and the clips differ in aspect ratio (832×512 versus 854×480).
The new clip is softer and lower quality than the original, so the join at 5 s will be visible.
The original's ending still shows a landing on the bare desk. The first 5 s can be kept, but the new ending is not a continuation of it.

summary: The agent delivered a 3 s ending clip in which the plane is still flying at the end and never lands on a notebook, plus the original clip for the user to join, so the requested 8 s video with a notebook landing was not produced.
